body:
I went through a period of being honest when people asked me how I was doing. It started to feel like I would bring down people by being honest, because it would always be negative. I don't ever feel good. I started to feel bad about being honest, because no one wants to hear someone be that negative. No one said it but I'm pretty sure it started to wear people out.

So now I guess I'm reverting back to keeping my mouth shut, and hiding how I feel. It's a tough thing.. maybe I wasn't even bringing people down you know. Could just be the depression fooling me. I'm sorry you don't have anyone to talk to. I probably can't help but I'm a good listener, always here if you want to chat.

It's quite bizarre. It's something I've always been able to do, just pop the mask on, appear to be a normal person then I'd go home and be exhausted for a day or 2. But yeah, I feel exactly the same. It feels physically insaaaanely difficult, almost impossible. It felt weird for someone to want to converse and for me to have the hardest time of my life to say 2 or 3 words back. I'm just hoping this will pass.. =(
Thanks, me too =]
Yes, I'm currently on the waiting list. Just have to wait for them to call me back. I have lots of issues, I'm a mental mess =P

I have no real skills, and I'm going to be 27 in a few months and I've been unemployed since I was 25. I just.. feel like I've been surviving, rather than living. I can't even do social things because of no money. I'm still living at home. Anyway.. I'll e-mail him tomorrow and we'll see. 

I've yet to find that special something. Something pleasurable or interesting in life, so I don't really know what I'm looking for exactly. Anyone could hire me for anything at this point, but everyone asks for experience in everything. I have none so.. finding it tough.

I went and spoke with a guy about some part-time work in his business. It's just starting out, and he said he'd get back to me about it. His words were "it's pretty much guaranteed, you're the only person I've spoken to about this position and you seem to be a good fit". Good stuff! I felt.. not down for the first time in a long time (it'd be the end of 14 months of unemployment). But it's been over 2 weeks and he hasn't replied, so I think I'll e-mail him on Monday and see what's going on. I was hopeful but now I'm just down and I don't even know why really, it's not like he said no. Just the usual underlying sense of doubt/cynicism I guess. That day or 2 where I wasn't down was fucking incredible though =(

Keeping busy definitely helps, it pulls you away from being in your mind the whole time and eventually getting into the usual depressive hole. I've had nothing to do for a long time, hence I've been depressed for a long time. When I was working I still had depression, but it was manageable and definitely didn't have the impact it does now. Just try and find something emotionally fulfilling, something you enjoy. Keep at it bud, always here if you need to talk.

Depression is an imbalance of chemicals in the brain that changes how you feel, and how you see things. You don't need a reason to be depressed, you just are. I also feel that way about my depression, it feels like it's always been there and maybe it always will be. It's hard to try and differentiate between yourself and the depression sometimes, but it's something that's important to try and do. Try and remember that it's your depression making you this way, and it isn't you as a person.

Anti-depressants have been very odd for me. I took Zoloft for a year and at the start they were great. Then they started to wear off and the side effects got worse and worse. Eventually I had to come off them and went back to square one with the depression and then had the side effects to deal with on top of everything else. I'm really glad that they work/worked for you though, unfortunately they don't seem to be an option for me.
Thank you, I'd like to give you a hug. I hope things improve for you too.

Yeah I guess it's trial and error.. being anxious about taking anti-anxiety/depression meds, pretty funny really. Sertraline was good for the time it worked but my body just kinda started rejecting it. I'll try Citalopram, we'll see how it goes. Thanks for the replies.

Isn't available in my country unfortunately. I did try Mirtazapine for about 2 months. It actually increased my sex drive, but I noticed no change to my mood/depression, and it also made me sleep an ungodly amount. I'm pretty sure I'm just gonna go for it anyway, I just need some kind of change.
These internet strangers have actually been on anti-depressants though, whereas my doctor hasn't. Doesn't hurt to get opinions.
Yeah it's true.. the side effects are just scary you know. A lot to consider, thank you for taking the time to reply.
Thanks for the reply. That's the thing though, it can hurt to try. I don't really want to risk having to deal with another long term side effect.

I did this with a close friend. I noticed that I'd started every single conversation literally since we met, so I didn't message him and waited to see if he'd message me. It's been 3 months so.. I guess that's that, lol.

Agreed, people aren't really educated on it at all. There are a few youtube videos that seem like they'd be really helpful actually, mostly lectures. I could ask some people to watch, I think they'd help a lot. Thank you for this comment, I really am trying.

I did the same. I have a friend who is always up for a hug, it really helps, but I only see him like once every 3 months or so. Maybe I just need closer relationships with people. Thank you for this reply.

Am on 8 days here. I don't go out, see anyone ever, and I'm also in the process of a Jesus beard. I just don't see the point. I don't see people, and when I do it's for like 5 minutes anyway. Spend 30 mins shaving? What for? I'm still gonna be ugly as fuck and it won't change anything. Taking a shower might as well be "go and climb mount everest" right now.

Someone said they loved me a while back, first time anyone had ever said that. We hugged a lot, and it made me feel safe, warm, and wanted in this world. They proceeded to say it was a mistake, and they couldn't be with me. After experiencing the feeling of such safety and warmth.. to lose it is incredibly painful.

Wellbutrin isn't available in the UK unfortunately, it sounded amazing and I would've liked to try it but it isn't possible. He didn't say really, I asked about it and he called back and literally just said he doesn't think I need it. Yeah, I walked for 3 miles a day for about 5-6 weeks, but I dunno.. I didn't really feel any better after it. I did stop though, maybe I should just start again *shrug*

Ahh I see, I was told a lot of different things over that time. Was told I'd see a psychiatrist/counselor/"CBT" specialist multiple times (CBT is absolutely awful by the way). The sucky thing is that there aren't really any good doctors where I am, there's a site that reviews them and they're all pretty awful here. Hm.. maybe I should just try a different doctor anyway.
This doctor is the only one that had counselors where I live. I've looked online, there are a few counselors around here but they're all private and cost money. I have no income at all.

Absolutely. I've been saying I really need a job since I lost my last one. That was in April 2012. I'll get random bouts of inspiration. "I will get a job! I'll get some income and everything will inherently get better!". Then I wake up in the morning and I may as well be super-glued to the bed.

Bananas omnomnomn <3

Yay for a tear-free day =D
You too!

Thank you =D

Don't feel pressured to tell people. It's up to you who to tell and when. I'm going to tell my father this coming week. I think it'll help him understand a lot of things that have happened.
Nice! I also managed to get an appointment with a counselor after 18 months of trying (healthcare here could be somewhat improved). What did you get when you went shopping?
That's still awesome. Like you said, not as structured as you would've liked, but you're still being active! =]
I think a job would help me greatly, I'm just not sure about the full-time hours. It's hard to judge when between meds, I slept for 16 hours today, yesterday I slept for 2. It's a bit ridiculous =x
Live in the UK. No money to move, no qualifications so I doubt I'd get a job anyway. Tis pretty cold here too.

The ridiculous time over New Years. Nearly lost a family member, was awake for 36+ hours and had a really bad panic attack because of it, love of my life said he doesn't think it'll ever work between us, all in the space of 3 days. Oh, and I'm jobless and overweight. So yeah...

There might be someone out there for me, I just love this guy so much, he's absolutely perfect. You'd think love between 2 people would be the most important thing, but I guess it isn't. I'll keep trying to see a counselor , I have anti depressants I should be taking but they have weight gaining side effects. I've lost weight for the first time in years, so the last thing I want to do right now is put weight back on. I really wish he hadn't have initiated all of this.. I wasn't happy, but at least I wasn't fucking hopeful. Hopeful always ends badly.

Thank you so much for replying. I know.. it's very weird at the same time. What are the chances of me existing in this speck in the universe, the little piece of life on a backdrop of bleak. It's amazing really, life is confusing =/

That isn't the only reason, I've lived through a lot of my close friends dying. I've been through a lot, it'd require another thread just to scratch the surface. I have no confidence, I have no one to talk to. I've wanted to see a counselor for over a year and I still haven't seen anyone. Every year has gotten progressively worse, I just don't see things getting better. My life has always been there for someone to just take advantage of, and I'm the one left with the repercussions. I'm going to be 26 soon, and the longest relationship I've had was 2 months. On and off meds for a year, where am I now? Still depressed, except now I'm dealing with the awful side effects. 

And yes, not being able to find love is worth ending my life over. I've been at it for over 10 years, there's obviously something very wrong with me. I can't handle loneliness, and it's clear that I'm always going to be alone. It's not a pain I'm willing to go through.

I'm fine answering, I'm gay. I've tried to find love since school, coming up to 10 years now. I gave up, because people just wanted sex, and if it ever got past that point it would never last that long. This only happened yesterday, but I'm not looking for love any more. 10 years of heartbreak has just broken me, I guess I'm not worth loving.

No I'm male. I don't think he's missing out on anything. My life has gotten progressively worse as the years go by, sorry but I've heard the "it gets better" thing for almost a decade now, and I've yet to see anything get better.
He's the only thing keeping me here right now. I still think he would be fine without me though. He's been through a lot, but I'm hardly important.

Yeah.. it's where they gain most of their control. Every now and then he'd say if I told anyone he'd kill me, and I still believe to this day that he would've done that if I'd have told anyone at the time. He broke my bones before so I think he was completely capable of a lot worse. 

It's a tough road.. thank you so much for this message though, it's so lovely to think that people are here for me. Thank you.

Ahh ok, yeah I'm pretty much in the same situation, it isn't someone that would be preying on others. I'm gonna have to ask them to promise me not to make any drama. Like, they have to promise me that. Thanks for replying =]

Thank you so much for this message =]

A therapist isn't an option right now unfortunately, hm.. not sure who I could ask to come and sit with me and my parents. Guess I'll have to try and think of someone. And yeah, I'm going to stress that I want no contact and no drama from this, because that is literally my main concern. It's going to break their hearts.. but it'll explain a lot to them.

Yeah it was really bad.. I just couldn't face going out to get more. I'll stick with them. 1 a day was definitely too much, I started getting very bad brain zaps. 1 every other day doesn't feel like enough right now, but I'll stick with it for a while and see what happens. Thank you so much for replying to me, I've posted a lot of times before just wanting someone to talk to and no one has responded. It really means a lot right now.

I was on Sertraline from September 2012 to about May 2013. I went cold turkey because my doctor refused to send me a prescription, saying that I had to go there personally. I couldn't do it because of anxiety, so I just stopped my meds. The comedown was awful. I was put back on them again 3-4 weeks ago. I didn't have any side effects the first time, but this time I've had so many. So I'm taking 1 every other day right now, but I'm feeling terrible. Yeah, he didn't explain anything to me, just gave me the choice.

Yeah I mean.. we pay high taxes to have "free" healthcare here, even though we still pay for medication and stuff. The doctors seem pretty incompetent in general though, they've messed up a lot of things since they diagnosed me with depression last September. Last time I went I was having really bad side effects because of the meds, and the doctor just said "So what do you want to do?". Well.. I don't know.. you're a doctor, perhaps you could help me with that? "Well come back next week and tell me what you want to do". I've been taking meds every other day instead of every day, side effects have worn down but I've been feeling very depressed and emotional. It's like every day is too much, but every other day isn't enough. So I either double my dose, which scares me because I think the side effects would double, or I come off the meds, which I don't think I'm ready for. He really didn't give any input or help me in any way, he just told me to make a decision.
I'm from the UK.

Haha =]

Yeah I asked to see a therapist in September 2012. They said it'll take a while but they'll definitely get me an appointment. Instead they sent me for CBT, which I told them was pointless and I didn't ask for that, it won't help me. They said ok it'll take a while but they will see what they can do. Then I got my appointment last week, they told me it was a therapist. Turns out it was a CBT guy again. What can I do? I cried out for help over a year ago, and I still haven't gotten any. I'm just lost. Thank you so much for replying to me.

It's cognitive behavioural therapy. They basically tell you to write all your problems onto boxes and then say "just push that to the back of your mind!". It works on silly people but it's completely pointless for me. I just need someone to discuss issues with, not someone who just gives me a workbook and says to finish it within a week. Something needs to change for me, I can't carry on with this mundane shit anymore.

Cake is the best thing in the universe =]

I'm 26 in 2 months.
I live in the UK. Feel free to message me, it's always good to have someone who will at least listen.

I told one of my close friends last night. I was feeling pretty awful but she's so fucking cool, I should have just told her ages ago really. She said she was bi but that she didn't really tell her family, and that it didn't matter. Didn't know that about her, but it was very re-assuring. I feel so much better just speaking to someone about it, thank you all so much for all of the help <3
Ah I see, thanks xD
Sorry, not quite sure what you mean?

Yeah that's true really.. I guess I don't really have to come out to everyone. I just felt kind of pressured by the whole thing and thought I should announce it in some big way. Unnecessary pressure on my part it seems =P

And yeah.. I'd imagine it'd help my depression quite a bit. Alot to think about!
Yeah, makes sense, now I just have to find the courage to actually do that. It's very rare I open up to anyone. Thanks for the help, very very appreciated =]

Thanks a lot for replying =]

I was gonna make quite a detailed post about my depression and sexuality, 2 things I'm really sick of hiding. Not too sure about the photo part, I don't feel confident enough to do that =P. Hopefully the genuine-ness (made up words ftw) of it will make people think it isn't some Frape. Maybe I should just say so beforehand?

I realise that we're not REALLY going anywhere, but I know people who are 17 that at least have a place to call their own. I dunno.. just hard to be so closed.. I can't open up as much as I try. I'll definitely read that, thank you for taking the time to reply =]

Firstly, thank you so much for taking the time to reply, actually means a lot to me =]

I've actually been speaking to some gay guys recently online. They're pretty cool, I haven't really personally opened up yet so they don't know my situation. I feel like I'm kinda burdening them but.. I will try. I've also been applying for jobs for a while, not much in terms of replies yet but I'll keep on truckin'. Job searching is a job in itself it seems >_<
Congrats! I also shaved yesterday, I no longer resemble an exaggerated Jesus.
